name: industrial
title: Industrial & facilities — logistics centres, factories, warehouses, HQ buildings
finish: large-format digital capture, fine natural grain, gentle highlight roll-off, no digital sharpening
spherical prime lens, honest geometry, slight halation where highlights burn, deep focus throughout
modern cinema camera with wide latitude, texture held in both the deepest shadow and the brightest window
high-resolution capture with true edge-to-edge sharpness, no vignette, no corner softness
a touch of anamorphic character — a subtle horizontal flare on bright sources, otherwise clean and undistorted
tripod at base ISO, absolute clarity, every surface texture legible
documentary stills camera, natural contrast curve, colour as the eye saw it, nothing pushed
no_text: Render every sign board, fascia, banner, panel and vehicle side as a CLEAN BLANK SURFACE. Absolutely no text, no letters, no Korean hangul, no numbers, no logos, no wordmarks anywhere in the image. Keep the shape, size, colour and position of the signage panels, but leave them empty.
negative: text, lettering, letters, words, typography, Korean hangul, numbers, signage text, logo, wordmark, brand name, captions, subtitles, watermark, garbled writing, architectural scale model, diorama, miniature, tilt-shift, 3D render, game engine, CGI, toy-like plastic, invented buildings, unrelated machinery, blown-out sky, dull washed-out colour
ignore: the reference's time of day and weather
all text, lettering and logos in the reference

materials.treatment: real surface evidence — weathering, dust, panel discolouration, scuffed floors, tyre marks, roof units, cable runs

focus: deep focus front to back, no tilt-shift, no fake background blur

still.B: the place immaculate and unpeopled, nothing in motion
still.J: nothing moves; the place is empty and at rest

modes.name: restrained cinematic
modes.direction: Photograph the place as a skilled cinematographer would on a real location — honest, grounded, human. Confident but never theatrical.
modes.licence: no additions: only what already exists in the reference
modes.light: the location's own available light, one soft directional key, natural contrast

cam.ext_air: eye-level from a nearby rise or upper floor, three-quarter, 35mm feel — grounded and human, not a drone shot
cam.ext_gnd: eye-level three-quarter from a natural standing position on the approach, 35mm feel
cam.ext_det: eye-level, standing back at a natural distance, the surface read in its full context, 50mm feel
cam.int: eye-level from where a person would actually stand in the aisle, three-quarter, 35mm feel
cam.obj: eye-level three-quarter from a normal walking distance, 50mm feel
cam.det: eye-level at natural working distance, 50mm feel

natural colour with restrained saturation, deep neutral blacks, warm surfaces against cool concrete
late afternoon, sun low and unobstructed, dry still air
warm highlights rolling off gently, shadows kept open and slightly blue, nothing pushed
overcast, an even soft sky, the ground still damp
cool desaturated base with a single warm accent, soft filmic contrast, blacks lifted a touch
compo: off-centre subject on a third, a leading line entering from the opposite lower corner
clear foreground, midground and background separated by light rather than by blur
a real foreground object cutting the lower corner, the subject held in the open middle

modes.name: brand film hero
modes.direction: The frame the client puts on their homepage. Formal, immaculate, everything reading proudly and clearly.
modes.licence: tidy the scene: clear accidental clutter, straighten what should be straight
modes.light: clean bright commercial lighting, directional but generous, no muddy shadows, everything legible

cam.ext_air: straight-on elevated frontal, subject centred and symmetrical, horizon dead level, 50mm feel
cam.ext_gnd: straight-on frontal, perfectly symmetrical, subject centred with even margins, 50mm feel
cam.ext_det: square-on to the surface, the panel centred and level, 85mm feel
cam.int: centred one-point down the exact middle of the space, perfectly symmetrical, 35mm feel
cam.obj: straight-on side elevation, subject centred and parallel to frame, 85mm feel
cam.det: square-on flat-lay, subject centred and level, 85mm feel

looks: clear bright day, no cloud, midday clarity

modes.name: epic scale
modes.direction: Make the viewer feel the sheer size of the operation. Endless repetition running to a distant vanishing point, the subject small against the scale around it.
modes.licence: EXPAND: multiply what is already there — more of the same trucks, racking, bays, machines, vehicles, filling the frame toward the horizon. Never a different kind of thing.
modes.light: one very low sun raking across the whole expanse, long shadows measuring out the distance, deep haze in the far layers

cam.ext_air: very high wide aerial, far back, the whole site small within an immense frame, 24mm feel
cam.ext_gnd: pull far back and up to a high vantage, the building one element in a vast landscape, 24mm feel
cam.ext_det: pull all the way back so the surface becomes one bright plane on an enormous facade, 24mm feel
cam.int: from the highest point the building allows, looking down the full length of the hall to a distant vanishing point, 24mm feel
cam.obj: high and wide from far back, the subject one of many arrayed across a vast yard, 24mm feel
cam.det: pull all the way back to reveal the entire hall the object sits in, 24mm feel

looks: golden hour, the sun very low, long shadows thrown across the whole site
warm amber key against cool blue shadow, deep atmospheric falloff, rich but never garish

compo: the subject small in the lower fifth beneath an enormous sky

one long diagonal running corner to corner across the whole expanse

modes.name: dramatic light
modes.direction: Light it like a film. Mood over information. Shape and atmosphere carry the frame, not detail.
modes.licence: ATMOSPHERE may be added — haze, mist, dust in the air, wet surfaces, low sun flare. Structures stay as they are.
modes.light: hard backlight through haze, visible shafts, deep silhouette, blazing rim, near-black shadow

cam.ext_air: low aerial shooting straight into the setting sun, the site in silhouette against blazing sky, 40mm feel
cam.ext_gnd: low and close to the ground, shooting into the light so the building reads as a dark shape against glare, 40mm feel
cam.ext_det: backlit from behind the plane, its edge glowing against a dark sky, 85mm feel
cam.int: low, shooting toward the brightest opening so the space reads in silhouette and shafts, 40mm feel
cam.obj: low, camera on the ground shooting into the key, subject rimmed in hard light, 40mm feel
cam.det: raking backlight across the subject, deep shadow falling toward camera, 85mm feel

looks: dusk, the last direct sun raking in almost horizontally through haze

near-monochrome cool base with hot amber practicals, extreme falloff
compo: a bright aperture at the centre of a dark surround, the eye pulled straight through
the subject as a dark silhouette mass across the lower two-thirds, light above it
hard shafts cutting diagonally across an otherwise dark frame

modes.name: blockbuster staging
modes.direction: Stage it like a hero shot from a feature film. Bold, theatrical, larger than life.
modes.licence: EXPAND: arrange multiples of the same subject in formation and add life and motion. Never a different kind of thing.
modes.light: strong low key with hard rim separation, dramatic falloff, practicals punching through, high contrast

cam.ext_air: steep dramatic aerial banking over the site, strong diagonal, dynamic converging perspective, 18mm feel
cam.ext_gnd: extreme low angle almost at ground level, the building towering into the top of frame, aggressive converging verticals, 18mm feel
cam.ext_det: extreme low looking steeply up the plane, dramatic perspective, 18mm feel
cam.int: camera on the floor looking up the aisle, structure towering overhead and converging, 18mm feel
cam.obj: camera at ground level a metre from the subject, it fills and towers over the frame, ranks of identical units receding behind, 18mm feel
cam.det: macro-close and low, the subject monumental in frame, 24mm feel

the hero filling two-thirds of frame with identical units receding behind it

modes.name: top-down graphic
modes.direction: Treat the place as pure geometry seen from above. Roofs, lanes, racks and markings become a flat graphic composition. Order and rhythm carry the frame.
modes.licence: EXPAND: fill the pattern out with more of the same units so the rhythm reads right across the frame. Never a different kind of thing.
modes.light: flat overhead light, colour and pattern carrying the frame rather than shadow

cam.ext_air: directly overhead top-down, the site reading as a flat graphic pattern of roofs, roads and yards, 35mm feel
cam.ext_gnd: steep high oblique from above the roofline looking down, the building a graphic mass among its surroundings, 35mm feel
cam.ext_det: looking down at a steep angle onto the facade plane, strong graphic geometry, 50mm feel
cam.int: from the ceiling structure looking straight down the aisles, racks and floor markings reading as pure pattern, 24mm feel
cam.obj: directly overhead looking down on the vehicle, its roof and the yard markings as graphic shapes, 35mm feel
cam.det: straight down onto the subject, flat graphic top-down, 50mm feel

modes.name: telephoto compression
modes.direction: Shoot it from far away on a long lens. Depth collapses, planes stack flat against each other, the subject is isolated and monumental within layered haze.
modes.licence: no additions beyond what already exists; the atmosphere between the layers may be deepened
modes.light: one distant source and layered atmosphere separating each compressed plane

cam.ext_air: long lens from a distant vantage, layers of the site stacked flat against each other, 200mm feel
cam.ext_gnd: long lens from far down the approach road, the building compressed against what lies behind it, 200mm feel
cam.ext_det: very long lens isolating the plane, background compressed to a flat field, 200mm feel
cam.int: long lens down the full length of the space, depth compressed so the racks stack into a dense wall, 135mm feel
cam.obj: long lens from far away, the vehicle isolated and flattened against a compressed background, 200mm feel
cam.det: long macro, subject isolated, background compressed to abstraction, 200mm feel

modes.name: in-the-action point of view
modes.direction: Put the viewer inside the work rather than in front of it. The camera is a person standing in the middle of it, close enough to touch something, with a real foreground element cutting into the frame.
modes.licence: PEOPLE AND MOTION may be added — workers, moving vehicles, parcels in transit — but only of the kinds already present.
modes.light: the practical sources inside the frame doing the work — fixtures, screens, machine lamps, headlights — mixed colour temperature left uncorrected

cam.ext_air: from a person standing on the roof deck or upper walkway of the building itself, looking out across the site, a railing or roof unit cutting into the near frame, 28mm feel
cam.ext_gnd: from a person walking in through the gate, a real foreground element — bollard, a parked truck's flank, the fence line — cutting into the near frame, 28mm feel
cam.ext_det: standing right beneath the surface looking along its length, the near edge cutting into frame, 28mm feel
cam.int: over the shoulder of a worker in the aisle, their back and shoulder holding the near third, the space opening out past them, 28mm feel
cam.obj: standing at the vehicle's front corner, close enough that the body curves away past the lens, another identical unit cutting the near frame, 28mm feel
cam.det: at hands distance, the near edge of the work surface cutting the bottom of frame, 35mm feel

modes.name: framed through
modes.direction: Find a real aperture in the place and shoot through it. A dark foreground frame holds a bright subject at its centre. Build the image in layers, never flat.
modes.licence: the foreground framing element must be something already present in this kind of place; nothing new in kind
modes.light: a bright space beyond a dark unlit foreground, a hard luminance step between the frame and the subject

cam.ext_gnd: shot through a real foreground aperture — between two parked trailers, through a gate frame, past a column — the building held inside the opening, 50mm feel
cam.ext_det: shot through a foreground gap so the surface sits framed and layered behind it, 85mm feel

cam.obj: shot between two other identical units, their dark flanks framing the hero vehicle in the gap, 50mm feel
cam.det: shot past a dark foreground object into the subject beyond, clear layered depth, 85mm feel

modes.name: dawn stillness
modes.direction: The place before the working day starts. Nobody moving, everything waiting. Wide, quiet, perfectly level, with at most a single long-exposure trace of motion.
modes.licence: EMPTY IT OUT: fewer people, the place at rest, surfaces still wet from the night. Nothing new in kind.
modes.light: the sky itself as the only soft source, with the few lights still burning as small warm points
